input.prompt: 16:9. Bright morning in the same small Auckland apartment, now tidy. Over-the-shoulder from behind a Korean woman in a soft knit top standing at the dining table, packing small skincare parcels into kraft boxes with tissue paper, a neat stack of finished parcels with shipping labels beside her; an open silver MacBook Pro on the table, its screen fully visible to us and showing one perfectly uniform flat bright chroma-key green image filling the display. Warm sunlight through the window, plants, calm and busy. Photograph taken with a Sony A7 IV and a 35mm f/1.8 lens, handheld, natural available light, true-to-life colour, realistic textures, crisp focus on the screen, natural optical bokeh, an unposed moment, documentary feel. Nobody looks into the camera. No readable text anywhere, no logos, no watermark.
